key_backup_text_1: Секретный ключ используется для генерации всех адресов. Любой, кто имеет доступ к секретному ключу, контролирует кошелек.
key_backup_text_2: Храните резервную копию секретного ключа в безопасном месте.
key_backup_text_3: Потеря секретного ключа приведет к потере доступа к вашему кошельку.
seed_phrase_backed_up: Я сделал резервную копию секретной фразы в безопасном месте.
confirm_backup_info: Select the requested words from your key seed phrase to confirm you have backed it up.
incorrect_backup_confirmation: Incorrect word. Please check your backup and try again.
key_seed_info: SSP Key and SSP Wallet must both be using unique, different seed phrases.
err_invalid_seed: Секретная фраза недействительна. Она должна содержать как минимум 12 слов.
err_pins_min_length: Пароль должен содержать не менее 8 символов
backup_needed: Необходимо сделать резервную копию секретной фразы, прежде чем синхронизировать ключ.
ssp_key_mnemonic_sec: Never share your seed phrase with anyone. Write the words down by hand, in order, and store the backup in a secure offline location. Avoid copying the seed phrase to your clipboard or taking screenshots — any application with clipboard or screen access could read it.
strong_password: Strong password should contain at least 8 characters, 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, 1 number, and 1 special character.
weak_password_info: Your password is weak which affects the security of your key.
weak_password_confirm: Would you like to change it?
weak_password_confirm_cancel: Yes, I want to change it.
rooted_device: Your device appears to be rooted! This significantly compromises the security of the SSP Key!
jailbroken_device: Your device appears to be jailbroken! This significantly compromises the security of the SSP Key!
ssp_key_2fa: SSP Key is the second signature for your SSP Wallet.
ssp_key_2fa_info: Install SSP Wallet browser extension first, then complete this SSP Key setup. Need help? Tap here.
